questions.question: Find the unit place digit in the expression {( {159} )¹⁴⁴} + {( {114} )¹²³} - {( {110} )⁵¹⁰} + {( {213} )²⁵}​
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

{( {159} )¹⁴⁴} + {( {114} )¹²³} - {( {110} )⁵¹⁰} + {( {213} )²⁵}

We will consider the unit digit of each number

Rightarrow {( 9 )¹⁴⁴} + {( 4 )¹²³} - {( 0 )⁵¹⁰} + {( 3 )²⁵}

⇒ 1 + 4 – 0 + 3 (consider only unit place digit of each sum)

⇒ 8

questions.question: The two equations x – 4y = 0 and 4x + 3y = 19 have a solution (a, b). Find the value of frac{{ab}}{{a + 4b}}.
questions.solution:
Given:

x – 4y = 0 ---- (i)

4x + 3y = 19 ---- (ii)

**Calculation:**

Multiplying eq 1 by 4 and rewriting both equations we get

4x – 16y = 0

4x + 3y = 19

On subtracting

⇒ -19y = -19

⇒ y = 1

Putting y = 1 in eq(i) we get

⇒ 4x - 16 = 0

⇒ x = 4

So the solution will be x = a = 4, y = b = 1 i.e. (4, 1)

**∴ value of ab/ (a + 4b) = (4 × 1) / (4 + 4 × 1) = 4/8 = 1/2**

questions.question: Which of the following statement is **CORRECT** about a triangle?

options.text: If the triangles are congruent then their area will be equal.
If the areas of two similar triangles are equal then the triangle is congruent.
Two congruent triangles are always similar to each other.

questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

By the definition of the congruent triangle,

Two triangles are congruent if they are equal in all respect with each other

In simple sense one should overlap other completely and if this is the rule then their area will be same and they are always similar to each other

But,

Two similar triangles may or may not be congruent

**∴ All options are correct regarding a triangle.**

questions.question: A box consist of 5 rupees, 2 rupees and 1 rupee coins and their value are in the ratio of 15 : 4 : 2 respectively. If there are total 112 coins, then how many 2 rupees coins are there in the box?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Total coins = 112

Value of 5, 2 and 1 rupee coins = 15 : 4 : 2

**Formula used:**

Total value = No. of coins × denomination

**Calculation:**

Let Rs. 15x be value of 5 rupees coins, Rs. 4x be the value of 2 rupees coins and 2x be the value of 1 rupee coins

According to the question,

15x/5 + 4x/2 + 2x/1 = 112

⇒ 3x + 2x + 2x = 112

⇒ 7x = 112

⇒ x = 16

**∴ 2 rupees coins are there in the box = 4x/2 = 2x = 2 × 16 = 32**

questions.question: The simple interest on a sum is 5/9 of the principal for 25 years. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Principal be 9 units, then Simple Interest (SI) = 5 units.

Time (T) = 25 years.

Rate (R) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T)

R = (5 × 100) ÷ (9 × 25) = 500 ÷ 225

R = 20/9 %

**∴ The correct answer is 20/9 %.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = 5/9 of Principal (P)

Time (T) = 25 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 Year 0
 Sum = P
 
 Year 25
 SI = 5/9 P
 
 

 

 
 Time = 25 years
 Rate = R%
 
 
 R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (5/9)P = (P × R × 25) ÷ 100

⇒ 5/9 = (25 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ 5/9 = R ÷ 4

⇒ R = (5 × 4) ÷ 9

⇒ R = 20/9 %

**∴ The correct answer is 20/9 %.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated only on the initial principal sum for the entire duration of the loan. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount (A)

The total accumulated sum at the end of the time period consisting of the principal and simple interest combined. Formula: A = P + SI = P[1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Rate of Interest

The percentage of the principal charged or earned per unit time. Computed directly by R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T).

questions.question: The marked price of a book is Rs. 4200. The shopkeeper gives two successive discounts of 25% and y% to the customer. If the customer pays Rs. 2898 for the book, then what is the value (in percentage) of y?
questions.solution:

M.P. = Rs.4200

Successive discount = 25% and y%

S.P. = Rs 2898

**Formula used:**

S.P. = M.P.( 1 - D₁/100)(1 - D₂/100)

where D₁ and D₂ are two successive discounts

**Calculation:**

According to the question

2898 = M.P × 75/100 × (1 – y/100)

⇒ 2898 = 4200 × 75/100 × (1 – y/100)

⇒ 2898/ (42 × 75) = (1 – y/100)

⇒ 2898/3150 – 1 = (-y/100)

⇒ (-252)/3150 = - y/100

∴ y = (252 × 100)/3150 = 8%

questions.question: P and Q undertook to do a work for Rs. 7200. P alone could do it in 20 days and Q alone in 12 days. With the assistance of R they ﬁnished the work in 5 days. What is the share (in Rs) of R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total wages = Rs.7200

No. of days P takes to do a work = 20 days

No. of days Q takes to do a work = 12 days

No. of days P + Q + R takes to do a work = 5 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

Wages ∝ Work and Work ∝ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the total work = 60 units

Efficiency of P = 60/20 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of Q = 60/12 = 5 units/day

Total efficiency of P + Q + R = 60/5 = 12 units/day

Efficiency of R = 12 – (3 + 5) = 4 units/day

The share will be divided on the basis of work done

**∴ Share of R = 4/12 × 7200 = Rs. 2400**

questions.question: A boat covers 143 km upstream in 13 hours and the same distance downstream in 11 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered = 143 km

Time taken to travel upstream = 13 hours

Time taken to travel downstream = 11 hours

**Formula used:**

If b is speed of boat and s is the speed of the stream, then

upstream speed = b - s

Downstream speed = b + s

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the boat and speed of the stream be x km/hr and y km/hr respectively

According to the question,

143/(x – y) = 13 ---- (i)

143/(x + y) = 11 ---- (ii)

On comparing both eq

11(x + y) = 13 (x – y)

⇒ 11x + 11y = 13x – 13y

⇒ 24y = 2x

⇒ x ∶ y = 12 : 1

∴ Speed of the boat in still water is 12 km/hr

questions.question: If 1 tonne of steel costs Rs. 30,000, then what was the cost (in Rs billion) of the steel production in the year 2017?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

We know, 1 Billion = 1000 Million

The cost of 1 ton of steel = Rs. 30000

production of steel in 2017 = 80 Million tonnes

So, 

cost of production in 2017

= 80 Million × 30000

= 80 Million × 100 × 300

= 8000 Million * 300

= 8B * 300

= 2400 Billion

**Hence, Rs. 2400 (in billion) is the correct answer.**

questions.question: The perimeter of a square is 26 cm. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of a square = 26 cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of square = 4a

Area of a square = a²

Where a → side of the square

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4a = 26

⇒ a = 26/4 = 6.5 cm

**∴ area of square = a² = 6.5 × 6.5 = 42.25 cm sq**

questions.question: The area of a circle is 616 cm². Find its radius (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of circle = 616cm²

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = πr²

where r → radius of a circle

**Calculation:**

⇒ πr² = 616

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 616

⇒ r² = 196

**∴ r = 14 cm**

questions.question: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a sphere whose diameter is 14 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = 14 cm,

So, r = 14/2 = 7 cm

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²

where r → radius of a sphere

**Calculation:**

r = 14/2 = 7 cm

**∴ Surface area of sphere = 4 × 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 616 sq.cm**
